issues: 落定后的中枢面板 820×520，正文 11–13px，在 1080p 里只是一片灰色小字纹理
五个集成图标是真实品牌的字形（设计工具、代码托管、CRM、网盘），出现真实产品名
光管是五色彩虹渐变，背景又叠了多色霓虹矩形，色相太多、主次不清
正反两面都是浅色白页，翻面前后材质相同，"换代"只靠内容变化，读不出来
changes: look 换成 aurora（紫粉暗场）；正面旧页做成白纸文档「Weekly sync — manual export」（46px 标题、28px 清单，近景可读），背面新中枢做成深紫玻璃「Everything, connected.」（66px 标题 + 五行 30px 数据源），材质反差把换代做实
五个集成换成虚构的 Tracker / Canvas / Ledger / Inbox / Vault：120px 深色玻璃瓷贴 + 白色线性图标，皇冠形围住中枢，名字放在不压管线的一侧
光管收成单色系：粉（集成端）→ 紫（中枢端）渐变 + 暗色底轨 + 白热芯，彗星脉冲沿 集成→中枢 持续输送；远景换成失焦的幽灵瓷贴做弱视差
判例节奏全部保留：35f 快翻尾缓、90° 侧棱 2f 闪、两拍制（52f 五瓷贴同帧 → 62f 五管同帧、9f 齐长）；接通同帧五行状态一齐从 Waiting 翻成 Synced、徽章 Idle→Live
余波加一行 30px 等宽统计「5 SOURCES · 2.4M RECORDS · SYNCED IN REAL TIME」逐词升起，尾帧是完整的生态海报
issuesEn: The settled hub panel was 820×520 with 11–13px body text, just grey texture at 1080p
The five integration icons were glyphs of real brands (design tool, code host, CRM, cloud drive), putting real product names on screen
The pipes used a five-colour rainbow over multicolour neon rectangles: too many hues and no hierarchy
Both faces were light white pages, so the flip changed content but not material and the new-era beat didn't read
changesEn: Aurora look (violet-pink dark). The front is a white paper doc "Weekly sync — manual export" (46px title, 28px checklist, readable in close-up); the back is a deep-violet glass hub "Everything, connected." (66px title + five 30px source rows), so the material contrast sells the new era
The integrations are now fictional Tracker / Canvas / Ledger / Inbox / Vault: 120px dark glass tiles with white line icons in a crown around the hub, labels placed on the side away from the pipes

Pipes are one colour family: pink at the app end to violet at the hub, with a dark groove and a white-hot core; comet pulses keep flowing app to hub, and the background is defocused ghost tiles with light parallax

All ruled timing is kept: 35f fast flip with soft landing, a 2f flash at 90°, two beats (52f all tiles at once, 62f all pipes at once, 9f grow); on connect all five rows flip from Waiting to Synced and the badge goes Idle to Live on the same frame
Follow-through adds a 30px mono stats line "5 SOURCES · 2.4M RECORDS · SYNCED IN REAL TIME" rising word by word, so the last frame is a complete ecosystem poster
